description: Tier-1 releases for the Report 2 news blackout (ADR-060, architecture 6.6), keyed on MT5 calendar event ids (MqlCalendarEvent.id), never on names. It ships EMPTY: the ids must come from production economic_events (plan decision D13) and cannot be invented. While events is empty or does not cover all four kinds (CPI, CORE_PCE, FOMC_RATE_DECISION, NFP) the offer check fails closed and Report 2 is not offered. Add an entry as { "eventId": "<digits>", "kind": "<kind>", "name": "<label>" } and raise listVersion by one.
